Studies.Name: container
Studies.PreStudyScript: kubectl patch deployment activator -n knative-serving -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name": "activator", "image": "lkondras/activator-ecd51ca5034883acbe737fde417a3d86:synchronous"}]}}}}'; sleep 60

Studies.Name: prepare_snapshots
Studies.PreStudyScript: mc rm --force -r minio/snapshots; kubectl patch deployment activator -n knative-serving -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name": "activator", "image": "lkondras/activator-ecd51ca5034883acbe737fde417a3d86:pulsenet-random"}]}}}}'; sleep 60
Studies.PreScript: for n in 3; do ssh 10.0.1.$n "tmux send-keys -t relay C-c"; done; sleep 10; for n in 3; do ssh 10.0.1.$n "tmux send-keys -t relay 'sudo ./relay -ss proxy -snapshots remote -dbg -netPoolSize 1 -endpoint 10.0.1.$n:8080 -upf -ws -wsRecording -j 16 -baseSnap 2>&1 > ~/relay.log' Enter"; done; sleep 30
Studies.PostScript: for n in 3; do ssh 10.0.1.$n "tmux send-keys -t relay C-c"; done; sleep 30; for n in 3; do scp 10.0.1.$n:relay.log $OUT_DIR/relay_$n.log; scp 10.0.1.$n:snapshots/hit_rates.csv $OUT_DIR/hit_rates_$n.csv; done; ssh 10.0.1.1 df /dev/nvme1n1p1 >> $OUT_DIR/storage.log

Studies.PostScript: for n in 3; do ssh 10.0.1.$n "tmux send-keys -t relay C-c"; done; sleep 30; for n in 3; do scp 10.0.1.$n:relay.log $OUT_DIR/relay_$n.log; scp 10.0.1.$n:snapshots/hit_rates.csv $OUT_DIR/hit_rates_$n.csv; done; ssh 10.0.1.1 df /dev/nvme1n1p1 >> $OUT_DIR/storage.log
